AudioFFT portable FFT provenance

Unmodified AudioFFT.h / AudioFFT.cpp and COPYING.txt from HiFi-LoFi/FFTConvolver:
https://github.com/HiFi-LoFi/FFTConvolver/tree/f2cdeb04c42141d2caec19ca4f137398b2a76b85
Revision f2cdeb04c42141d2caec19ca4f137398b2a76b85 (non-uniform branch).
HiFi-LoFi copyright 2017, MIT license retained in COPYING.txt and source headers.
Only the portable Ooura implementation is built; no FFTW or Accelerate dependency.
FFTConvolver / TwoStageFFTConvolver sources are NOT included or built.

AudioFFT's embedded radix-4 FFT is based on Takuya Ooura's FFT package.
Current upstream permission, retrieved 24 November 2026:
https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~ooura/fft.html

Copyright Takuya OOURA, 1996-2001

You may use, copy, modify and distribute this code for any purpose (include
commercial use) and without fee. Please refer to this package when you modify
this code.

The earlier readme bundled in fft.zip has narrower distribution wording. The
current author-published permission above expressly includes modification and
distribution. Retain both attribution and the AudioFFT MIT license in binaries.
